To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Ru-decorate VGNS@Ni foams are an efficient binder-free cathode with high specific capacity, low charge overpotential and good cycling stability for Li-O2 battery.
Ru-decored VGNS/Ni foam can be used as cathode catalysts in Li-O2 batteries to significantly reduce the charge voltage and improve the cycling stability of Li-O2 batteries.
Ru-decored VGNS/Ni foam can significantly reduce overpotentials via the effects of OER, and the Ru-decoration can improve the catalytic activity of the VGNS/Ni electrode.

the development of a new cathode material for Li-O2 battery with high specific capacity, low overpotential and good cycle stability.

the development of a three-dimensional porous graphene-based material as an efficient cathode catalyst for lithium-oxygen (lithium-air) batteries with low charge potential and high round-trip energy efficiency.

The main takeaway from our work is that

Ru-decorating vertically aligned graphene nanomaterials on a conductive substrate is an efficient way to reduce the charge overpotentials and achieve high reversible capacity for Li-O2 battery cathodes.
the Ru-decorate VGNS/Ni foam electrode is a promising cathodic catalyst for rechargeable lithium-oxygen batteries with low charge voltage, long cycle life, and high specific capacity.
